A1.justification: Local reading commands, including PDF text extraction, stalled without returning document content. The supplied filenames identify the intended pair, but the work's identity and material completeness could not be verified. This is an access limitation, not evidence of missing PDF content.

before.justification: No document content was obtained from v2.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be assessed.

after.justification: No document content was obtained from v3.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be assessed.

M1.justification: The method descriptions and equations were unavailable, preventing comparison of algorithms, architectures, objectives, and procedures.

E1.justification: Neither version's experimental content could be inspected to establish dataset, task, or test-scenario coverage.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, so comparator membership could not be checked across corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Experimental settings could not be read, preventing assessment of protocol changes versus newly disclosed details.

E4.justification: The main text and appendices were unavailable for checking changes to ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty reporting could not be inspected in either version.

E6.justification: Result passages, tables, and figures were unavailable, preventing verification of numerical changes, added entries, or qualitative findings.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected or matched between versions.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were unavailable, preventing comparison of core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations could not be read, so substantive changes could not be distinguished from restatement or relocation.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures were unavailable for comparison.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and references could not be inspected to identify citation or research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: No document text was obtained, preventing assessment of language editing, terminology, or structural revisions.

P2.justification: Neither PDF could be visually inspected, preventing comparison of figures, tables, captions, and layout.

improvement.justification: The local reading tools returned no usable PDF content, leaving no verified before-and-after evidence for assessing overall quality. No external evidence was consulted.
